notes.title: Card of Legend Grand Launch Update List
notes.content:
[h3]Hello, adventurers![/h3]

We're unleashing a colossal update packed with exciting new content, strategic changes, and highly requested improvements to celebrate our Grand Launching.
 
[h3]Here's a rundown of the epic changes awaiting you:
[/h3]
[b]⚔️ Strategic Combat Updates⚔️[/b]

- Unit Attack Order Overhaul: 
  [list]
[*]  	Attack sequence: Flying > Melee > Ranged
[*]    Units with the Quick Attack keyword will always strike first within their attack type
[/list]- Shop Reroll Discount: 
   [list]
[*] 	Initial cost to reroll in the Shop: 500 Gold > 100 Gold
[/list][b]🗺️ Adventure Mode🗺️[/b]

- New Chapters Unveiled: 
[list]
[*]    Holy, Dark
[/list]- Visual Upgrade on Metal Chapter: 
   [list]
[*] New stunning background board for battles in the Metal Chapter
[/list]- Double the Spoils! 
   [list]
[*] Victory spoils in Adventure Mode battles: 2x loot
[/list]- Enhanced Elite and Boss Battles: 
   [list]
[*] Level of difficulty increased for Elite and Boss encounters, demanding strategic deck building and skillful play
[/list]- Achievement System Added: 
 [list]
[*]   Conquer each adventure for the first time to earn valuable rewards through our brand new Achievement system!
[/list]- Exclusive Title Await: 
  [list]
[*]  A unique title for clearing each adventure for the very first time.
[/list]- Enki's Blessing Preview: 
 [list]
[*]   A list of currently-held Blessings can now be seen when selecting Enki's Blessing after a battle
[/list]- Improved Battle AI: 
  [list]
[*]  Battle AI upgraded for a more intelligent and engaging enemy behavior.
[/list]

[b]🃏 Card Adjustments🃏[/b]

- Kei: 
   [list]
[*] Keyword removed: Guardian 
[*]  Stat boost: Attack and HP
[/list]- Ashley: 
   [list]
[*] Skill count limit applied.
[/list]- Fiona: 
  [list]
[*]  Fiona can no longer be retrieved from the graveyard by her own skill.
[/list]- Blueveil: 
  [list]
[*]  Skill target conditions changed: Enemy units based on speed > Ranged enemy units
[/list]- Thunderbolt: 
   [list]
[*] Number of targets: 3
[/list]

[b]✨ Rebalancing Enki's Blessing✨[/b]

- Thornbush: 
[list]
[*]    Target changed: All enemies > 3-4 random enemies
[*]    Activation odds reduced
[/list]- Soul Breaker: 
[list]
[*]    Damage reduced to 2, and the activation odds have been adjusted.
[/list]- Portable Fan: 
[list]
[*]    This Blessing has been removed from the game.
[/list]- Broken Shackles: 
[list]
[*]    Activation odds reduced
[/list]- Megaphone: 
[list]
[*]    Activation odds reduced
[/list]- Helm of Quietude: 
[list]
[*]    Target changed: All enemies > 3-4 random enemies
[*]    Activation odds reduced
[/list]- Healing Bandage: 
[list]
[*]    Activation conditions changed: All the time > Under activation odds.
[/list]

[b]👾 Monster & Magic Card Updates 👾 [/b]

- Swampshile: 
[list]
[*]    No longer eliminates slower enemies
[*]    Inflicts Bind twice on ranged enemies
[/list]- Spiked Jellyfish: 
[list]
[*]    Added keywords Can’t Attack and Counter.
[/list]- Flaming Sharpshooter: 
 [list]
[*]   The condition to eliminate an enemy now includes “Attack Power at a certain number or less.”
[/list]- Giant Buzzer: 
 [list]
[*]   Skill target changed from all units to a set number of units.
[/list]- Boss Monsters (Ice/Fire/Grass/Mechanical Dragon Series, Fallen Angel, Dark Angel):
 [list]
[*]   Added keyword Counter.
[*]    Cost: 3 > 4
[/list]- Magma Greatsword: 
[list]
[*]    Now damages a fixed number of random enemies
[*]    Cost: 2 > 3
[/list]- Boggy Swamp: 
[list]
[*]    Speed condition for the skill target removed. 
[*]    Only targets ranged enemy units.
[/list]- Infectious Roots: 
 [list]
[*]   Summoned units now fixed at 2.
[/list]- Mechronite: 
[list]
[*]    Activation conditions changed: Sacrifices a selected ally > Activates when a selected ally dies.
[/list]- Adaptive Shield:
[list]
[*]    Skill change: Removing an ally's shield > Grants a shield or adds HP if a shield already exists.
[/list]
[i]Note: To focus our efforts on expanding the core adventure experience, we have decided to remove the Dungeon content for our Grand Launch. [/i]

Dive in, explore the new adventures, refine your strategies, and become the ultimate Legend!

Happy Battling!

-	The Card of Legend Team

notes.title: Card of Legend Official Launching with a Massive Update!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45192221/035c34303c968cc0c732a18faa1b7fe0b387fa0f.jpg[/img]

[h3]Hello, adventurers![/h3]

The day we've all been waiting for has finally arrived! 

We are absolutely thrilled to announce the official launch of Card of Legend! 
[h3]Date and Time: 4th April, 2025 6:22 A.M. (UTC)[/h3]

To celebrate, we're unleashing a massive update packed with exciting new content, strategic changes, and highly requested improvements. 

[h3]Here's what’s in store for the Grand Launch![/h3]
1.⚔️ Strategic Combat Updates⚔️
2. 🗺️ Adventure Mode Updates🗺️
3. 🃏 Card Adjustments🃏

[i]*The link will become available after the official launch.[/i]

We are incredibly excited for you to experience all these new changes and the official launch of Card of Legend! 

Also, we're offering a special 40% discount for all players!
This limited-time promotion will run for 14 days starting from the launch date – so don’t miss your chance to join the adventure at a discounted price!
[list]

[*] Discount: 40% off[/b][/list]
Dive in, explore the new adventures, refine your strategies, and become the ultimate Legend!

Happy Battling!

-	The Card of Legend Team

notes.title: Unleash the Adventure: New Content Update!
notes.content:
"Get ready to dive into the exciting content of Card of Legend! We’re thrilled to introduce new content features that will take your gameplay experience to the next level."

[b]1.	Multi-languages Added[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45192221/6983b0d1321c5926d6aa0ce19da88b8026046656.png[/img]
We’ve expanded our language support so that even more players can enjoy Card of Legend! Now you can experience the game in:
•	Korean
•	English
•	Japanese - NEW
•	Chinese (Simplified) - NEW
•	Portuguese - NEW
•	Spanish - NEW

[b]2.	New System: “Memory Fragment”[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45192221/d6f76aae39513e1b6a1135c95ac3a81a5014de3e.png[/img]
Uncover more of the world’s hidden lore with our all-new Memory Fragment system:
•	Memory Fragment Acquisition: Earn fragments each time you clear a stage.
•	Discover the Backstory: Piece together the past, learn how the main character received their power, and find out the origin of the war against the devil.

[b]3.	Expanded Adventure Contents and Upgraded Effects[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45192221/d133c734eed480d99ade49407ce940500096cf5b.png[/img]
Embark on new chapters, each with varied difficulties to test your skill:
•	New Chapters: Deepwood Forest, Underwater Kingdom, Volcanic Zone, and Steel City.
•	Difficulty Levels: Tackle each stage on Easy, Normal, Nightmare, or Hell.
•	Upgraded Effect: Get ready to experience a whole new level of immersion! We’re introducing enhanced elemental effects that perfectly align with each monster and skill, pulling you deeper into the action. Brace yourself for more dynamic battles and captivating gameplay in every encounter!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45192221/14143d3918144364e06ca7ec5d77a8a670198fe5.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45192221/6361c9ae55ead0762576e79695b99f37adf1ff83.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45192221/41e2ac4dfe4e5840f123f6ccb96f9c928d7516e5.png[/img]

[b]4. More stages added to Ruins of Trials contents[/b]
Prepare for greater challenges! We’ve added more stages to "Ruins of Trials," offering even bigger rewards for those who dare to venture deeper.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45192221/df289240c32d33cfca3f4d63f10b1b4daa35765e.png[/img]

[b]5.	More Rewards[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45192221/8b3eab7f953401cb4e003e1d35bb9a9b98066e96.png[/img]
Your heroism will now be rewarded more generously:
•	Card Rewards: Earn a new card each time you clear every level in a chapter (one-time reward upon first clear).
•	Accumulated Stage Clears: Collect extra rewards for every milestone you reach.
•	Title System: Unlock unique titles for completing special achievements.
Prepare to flaunt your achievements! You can now display your title in the Ranking, PvP, and Lobby areas. Let everyone see your glory and take your place among the elite!


[b]6. Cards and Skills[/b]
12 New Playable Cards
Collect them all—there are now 112 different cards to gather!
Card Re-Balancing & Graphic Renewal
All cards have been updated for a more balanced and visually engaging experience.
61 Monster Cards
Discover even more fearsome foes across a variety of map locations.
16 Adventure Skills Added
Expand your tactical approach with these brand-new skills, perfect for exploring and conquering new territories.

[b]7. More Items for Enhancement[/b]
*18 New Enhancement Materials*
In addition to the 4 materials introduced during the SNF period, you now have 18 more items to power up your gear and cards.

notes.title: Leveling Up: Exciting Game Improvements!
notes.content:
We’re constantly working to make Card of Legend even better for you, and we’re excited to share some major improvements. Thank you so much for all your feedback during SNF period. 

[b]1. Story Renewal[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45192221/b324f65835b46cc08b40168c53b2dd21534bdffc.png[/img]
We’ve reworked the game’s story to immerse you more deeply into the realm of Card of Legend:
•	Story Revamp: Dive into a richer narrative that enhances your gameplay experience.
•	Opening Scene Added: Kick off your adventure with an all-new cinematic introduction.

[b]2. Tutorial Renewal[/b]
The Tutorial chapter is redesigned to be clearer and more engaging for new and returning players:
•	Revamped Design: Navigate a smoother learning curve with an updated layout.
•	Enhanced Narrative: Enjoy a cohesive storyline that guides you through the basics of gameplay.

[b]3. UI Improvements[/b]
We’ve streamlined the user interface to make your gameplay more intuitive:
A)	Element Filters: Easily spot element filters in color, even when they’re turned off.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45192221/3f9e71347ce7eb1949fb1528055412facfc3110f.png[/img]
B)	Battle & Angels: Detailed Info
Right click the card to see even more in-depth information about your characters and cards. Now you can check while you’re playing! 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45192221/70d256856b978e560576c5cfc1c110282446bce1.png[/img]
 Also, you can check all information of your angels on Angelpedia
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45192221/836777587d7bcbf178fd9763985f4128c4a1d000.png[/img]
-	Attack Order Visibility
Plan your strategy by seeing exactly which cards will attack next by clicking ‘eye’ button on the bottom right on the battle scene.
-	Card Pop-Up Details
Click on any card to view its information—target details, counterattack opportunities, and damage breakdowns are now all at your fingertips.

[b]4. Changes to Card Replacement Rule[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45192221/e840f725a129c5b3da27d1514d0e63ec24d86c4f.png[/img]
We’ve revised the card replacement rules to give you more control:
•	Optional Replacement: You’re no longer forced to exchange cards at the start of the game if you don’t want to.
•	Mode-Based Rules:
o	PvP / Ruins of Trials: 0 ~ 1 card
o	Adventure: 0 ~ 2 cards
*Now you can check detailed information by right clicking the card.

[b]5. Event Expansion : “Unknown” Event[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45192221/651a764f5313c5b1059e0f1b06b8232bc9d52370.png[/img]
You will be able to find more stories on “Unknown” Event while playing adventure mode.

[b]6. Improvements on PvP Contents[/b]
All-Day PvP Availability
Battle opponents whenever you want—PvP is now open 24/7.
Bi-Weekly Season Resets
Seasons now reset every two weeks, ensuring a fresh competitive environment.
Free Arena Pass & EXP Rewards
Earn experience based on your Arena performance, level up your pass, and snag rewards at each new level.

[b]7. Arena UI Improvement[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45192221/5e2c3c114450e6e2dc45e5e35bd97381245ef896.png[/img]
Rank History
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45192221/05125f28a78f0ea2fdc07b60be9990f9cec60241.png[/img]
Keep track of both your previous and current season ranks in one convenient place.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45192221/a6bcb1cd3a2672cbf8f13ff5c8ff01b03a556708.png[/img]
Player Information : View deck details (yours and your opponents’), matching history, ranking overview, and more.

8. More feature
- You can edit your deck on your deck selecting interface. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45192221/35ae4800536d9cf2eff1e007cdfc84a8a76cd255.png[/img]
- You can filter cards included in your deck and which deck it is included on the Upgrade interface.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45192221/05aec0eaa0fc1f5a4f4ecf45de5e3ddec0c7ecda.png[/img]
Thank you for your continued support—these improvements are just the beginning, and we can't wait to bring you even more exciting updates soon!

[b]-	Card of Legend Team[/b]

notes.title: Letter from Developer (Early Access is coming soon on 3rd of Feb)
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45192221/1c0a87c885cfddc0e2c793d5f41ea613ce20340c.png[/img]

[h3][b]Dear Adventurers,[/b][/h3]

Thank you so much for your patience as we prepare for the Early Access launch of Card of Legend! 

We’re excited to present our Developer’s Letter, highlighting a range of exciting changes and new features. Dive into the details below and get ready to return to the world of “Card of Legend” with plenty of fresh adventures!

[h3][b]What's coming : [/b][/h3]
[olist]
[*]Multi-language system
[*] Main Story Renewal
[*] Tutorial Renewal
[*] New system: “Memory Fragment”
[*] Various UI improvements (based on SNF feedback)
[*] Revised Playing Rules
[*] More content added to the "Unknown" Event
[*] Additional Adventure Content
[*] Enhanced Elemental Effects
[*] More Stages in “Ruins of Trials”
[*] PvP Content Improvements
[*] More Angels and Skills
[*] More Enhancement Items
[*] Even More Features!
[/olist]

Stay Tuned!
We hope you enjoy these exciting updates and improvements. Thank you for your continued support and passion for Card of Legend. There’s more in store, so stay tuned for separate announcements with deeper insights into each update!
Once again, thank you for your patience and for joining us on this adventure. We’ll be back soon with all the latest news—see you in the game!

[h3][b]— The Card of Legend Team[/b][/h3]
